When do Americans exercise?

On an average weekday, the share of Americans exercising or playing sports peaks at 6:45 PM, when 2.8% of people age 15 and older (about 7.0 million) are exercising or playing sports. On weekends it peaks at 2:15 PM (3.5%). Averaged over all days, Americans spend 20 min a day exercising or playing sports.

What it includes

Average time per weekday, for the activities in this group that take the most time.

  • Walking: 3 min a day
  • Working out, unspecified: 2 min a day
  • Weightlifting/strength training: 2 min a day
  • Participating in water sports: 1 min a day

About these numbers

Estimates come from all 258,954 diaries in the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics and Census Bureau), 2003–2025, weighted to the U.S. civilian population age 15 and older and pooled across years. Times are local clock time. Counts are people on an average day of that type, not a live count. Weekdays are Monday–Friday. How the estimates work.
